description: Write a standard operating procedure (SOP) for a business process: purpose, scope, roles and responsibilities, numbered steps with who does each one and what to do at each decision, and a RACI matrix. Use it when the user wants an SOP, work instruction, procedure document, process documentation, RACI or onboarding guide for a process. Pass a process diagram link from an earlier result (flowchart, swimlane or BPMN), or a description of the process and it is drawn first. The steps and roles always match the diagram. Returns the SOP as Markdown plus a link that opens it next to the diagram in AI Flowchart. Uses 1 AI credit.

description.description: Only when there is no diagram yet: the process in detail — the steps in order, who does each (roles/teams), decisions and their outcomes.

diagram.description: Link (https://aiflowchart.io/import/<id>) or id of a flowchart, swimlane or BPMN diagram made earlier. Leave out to use description.

name: create_sop
title: Write an SOP from a process
